### data joining
```{r}

ds <- readRDS(path_melc_seurat)
ds$Cluster[ds$Cluster == "CD163+ Macrophages"] <- "Macrophages" # Oliver.Dietrich@helmholtz-hiri.de email 20.05.2021

data <- data.frame(
  CD163   = ds@assays$MELC@data["CD163", ],
  HLADR   = ds@assays$MELC@data["HLADR", ],
  Cluster = ds@meta.data$Celltype
)

cutoff_false <- quantile(data$CD163[data$Cluster == "Macrophages"], 0.5) # olis definition of cutoff

data$Cluster[data$Cluster == "CD163+ Macrophages"] <- "Macrophages"

cutoff_corrected <- quantile(data$CD163[data$Cluster == "Macrophages"], 0.5) # olis definition of cutoff

 # quantile(data$CD163[data$Cluster == "T cells"], 0.62)
non_myeloid_cluster_names <- c("Neutrophils","T cells", "NK cells","B cells")
CD163_non_myeloid <- data %>% filter(Cluster %in% non_myeloid_cluster_names) %>% pull(CD163)
CD163_myeloid <- data %>% filter(!Cluster %in% non_myeloid_cluster_names) %>% pull(CD163)

non_myolid_quantile_at_cutoff <-mean(CD163_non_myeloid<cutoff_corrected)
non_myolid_quantile_at_false_cutoff <- mean(CD163_non_myeloid<cutoff_false)

macrophage_quantile_at_false_cutoff <- mean(CD163_myeloid<cutoff_false)

cutoff <- cutoff_corrected
```

the cutoff for grouping Macs into CD163+/- that was chosen in the paper (arbirartly the median of CD163 in the data slot) was `r cutoff_corrected`
In the analysis I used the median of a previously grouped Macrophages set, which was
`r cutoff_false`.
Since this macrophages set didn't include all the latter CD163+ macrophages the percentage of CD163+ Macs in this analysis wasn't 50% of all Macs  but only `r macrophage_quantile_at_false_cutoff`

The correct median of CD163 in all macs is at the `r non_myolid_quantile_at_cutoff` percentile the incorrect value at the `r non_myolid_quantile_at_false_cutoff` of all non-myeloid clusters.

### creating different groupings of 'in', 'adjacent' and 'out'
```{r echo=FALSE}
all_cells <- all_dat %>% mutate()
all_dat <- all_dat %>% filter(new_celltype=="Macrophages"|new_celltype=="Neutrophils")
all_dat <- all_dat %>% 
  mutate(dist_to_coll4_grouped_large=ifelse(dist_to_coll4_large<=6,"in", ifelse(dist_to_coll4_large>20,"out",
      "adjacent"))) %>% 
  mutate(dist_to_coll4_grouped_all=ifelse(dist_to_coll4_all<=6,"in", ifelse(dist_to_coll4_all>20,"out",
      "adjacent"))) %>% 
   mutate(dist_to_coll4_grouped_all_7=ifelse(dist_to_coll4_all<=7,"in", ifelse(dist_to_coll4_all>20,"out",
      "adjacent"))) %>% 
  mutate(dist_to_coll4_grouped_weak=ifelse(dist_to_coll4_large<=6 & dist_to_coll4_all<6,"in", ifelse(dist_to_coll4_all>20,"out",
      ifelse(dist_to_coll4_large>6 & dist_to_coll4_all<6,"weak", "adjacent"))))

```

### paper cutoff, location of Macs relative to collagen 4
```{r}

all_dat <- all_dat %>% filter(new_celltype=="Macrophages")
#make pipline function: https://github.com/andrew-couch/Tidy-Tuesday/blob/master/Season%201/Scripts/TidyTuesdayFunctions.Rmd line 57
prop_maker <-  function(df, CD163_group) 
  {CD163_group <- enquo(CD163_group)
  df %>% filter(!!CD163_group %in% c("CD163_pos", "CD163_neg")) %>%
    mutate(celltype_grouped=as_factor(!!CD163_group), 
         dist_to_coll4_grouped=as_factor(dist_to_coll4_grouped_all_7),
         SourceID=as_factor(SourceID)) %>% 
   #count n of combinations Marker+/- and col_in/col_out
  #group_by(marker__grouped, dist_to_coll4_grouped,SourceID) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% 
   count(celltype_grouped, dist_to_coll4_grouped,SourceID, .drop = F) %>% 
  mutate(all_combos=paste0(celltype_grouped,"_",dist_to_coll4_grouped)) %>% 
  mutate(id=paste0(SourceID,celltype_grouped, dist_to_coll4_grouped)) %>% 
  group_by(SourceID) %>%
  mutate(all_combos_rel=n/sum(n))%>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SourceID, dist_to_coll4_grouped) %>% mutate(prop_col_status=n/sum(n)) %>% 
  mutate(prop_col_status=ifelse(!is.na(prop_col_status), prop_col_status,0)) %>% 
  mutate(sum=sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SourceID, celltype_grouped) %>% mutate(prop_celltype=n/sum(n)) %>% 
  mutate(pos_neg_rel=ifelse(!is.na(celltype_grouped), celltype_grouped,0)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% left_join(source_id_dpso_pa_covid_id)%>% 
  mutate(all_combos=factor(all_combos, levels= c("CD163_pos_in","CD163_pos_adjacent","CD163_pos_out",                                       "CD163_neg_in",  "CD163_neg_adjacent", "CD163_neg_out")))}
      
dat <- all_dat %>% prop_maker(CD163_group=CD163_oli)
 
symnum_args_6 <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1)/6, symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
symnum_args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))


perc_plot <-   function(df){df %>%  filter(!is.na(dpso)) %>% #filter(weird=="norm") %>% 
  ggboxplot(x="all_combos", y="all_combos_rel",  color= "dpso",add = "jitter", fill="dist_to_coll4_grouped", title =  "CD163+/- Mac location to Coll.4, % of all Macs/FOV" ) + stat_compare_means(aes(label = ..p.signif..),symnum.args = symnum_args_6,paired = T,comparisons = list(c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_pos_adjacent") ,c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_pos_out"), c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_neg_in"),c("CD163_pos_out", "CD163_neg_out"), c("CD163_neg_out", "CD163_neg_in"), c("CD163_neg_adjacent", "CD163_neg_in")))+ rotate_x_text(45)+scale_fill_manual(values=rev(wes_palette("Cavalcanti1")[c(5,4,1)]))}

p1 <- perc_plot(dat)
#ggsave(paste0("fig4s_v2021_06_17/","mac_proportion_of_celltype_umap_cuttoff_all7.eps"), height = 7)
#ggsave(paste0("fig4s_v2021_06_17/","mac_proportion_of_celltype_umap_cuttoff_all7.png"), height = 7)

   filter(!is.na(dpso)) %>% #filter(weird=="norm") %>% 
  ggboxplot(x="all_combos", y="n",  color= "dpso",add = "jitter",  fill="dist_to_coll4_grouped", title =  "CD163+/- Mac location to Coll.4, n/FOV" ) + stat_compare_means(aes(label = ..p.signif..),symnum.args = symnum_args_6, paired = T,comparisons = list(c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_pos_adjacent") ,c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_pos_out"), c("CD163_pos_in", "CD163_neg_in"),c("CD163_pos_out", "CD163_neg_out"), c("CD163_neg_out", "CD163_neg_in"), c("CD163_neg_adjacent", "CD163_neg_in")))+ rotate_x_text(45)+scale_fill_manual(values=rev(wes_palette("Cavalcanti1")[c(5,4,1)]))}
```

```{r}
##https://slowkow.com/notes/ggplot2-color-by-density/
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
#> Loading required package: viridisLite
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))

# Get density of points in 2 dimensions.
# @param x A numeric vector.
# @param y A numeric vector.
# @param n Create a square n by n grid to compute density.
# @return The density within each square.
get_density <- function(x, y, ...) {
  dens <- MASS::kde2d(x, y, ...)
  ix <- findInterval(x, dens$x)
  iy <- findInterval(y, dens$y)
  ii <- cbind(ix, iy)
  return(dens$z[ii])
}


px_data$density <- get_density(px_data$CD163,px_data$C1Q, n=100)
px_data %>% ggplot(aes())+geom_point( aes(x=CD163, y=C1Q, color=density), size=0.7)+ scale_color_viridis()

px_data_pos <- px_data %>% filter(C1Q>0.05  | CD163>0.05)
px_data_pos$density <- get_density(px_data_pos$CD163,px_data_pos$C1Q, n=100)
px_data_pos %>% ggplot(aes())+geom_point( aes(x=CD163, y=C1Q, color=density), size=0.7)+ scale_color_viridis()
```
